niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs and measurement requirements. Below is a practical way to think about choosing one, plus reputable options by type.

How to decide
- Campaign objective: brand awareness vs direct response vs attribution-driven sales changes who’s best.  
- Scale vs specialization: large holding groups provide scale and cross-channel integration; smaller CTV-first shops typically move faster and may offer better CTV-native expertise.  
- Buying method: programmatic DSP, platform-direct (Roku/Hulu/Amazon), or guaranteed/settled buys affects targeting and measurement.  
- Measurement & attribution: ask about deterministic IDs, cross-screen deduplication, incrementality testing and third-party verification.  
- Creative capabilities: dynamic creative, versioning for CTV and creative-for-TV experience matter.  
- Budget & reporting cadence: some agencies require minimums; request transparent reporting and access to raw data.

Reputable options (by type)
- Full-service media groups (best for scale and cross-channel strategy): GroupM (Mindshare/Wavemaker/Essence), Omnicom (OMD/PHD), Publicis (Starcom/Zenith), Dentsu (Carat/iProspect), IPG (UM/Initiative).  
- Programmatic DSPs & platform sellers (used either directly or via agency partners): The Trade Desk, Google DV360, Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads, Samsung Ads.  
- CTV-specialist partners (strategy, buying, measurement & creative optimized for CTV): Simulmedia, Innovid, Tremor (Tremor Video), Cadent, VideoAmp.  
- Platforms you may buy directly on for targeted reach: Roku, Hulu, Pluto/Paramount+, Samsung, Vizio/LG platforms — many offer managed services or agency partnerships.

What to ask when evaluating agencies
- Show me 2–3 CTV case studies for advertisers like us (industry, KPIs, results).  
- How do you buy CTV inventory (DSPs, publisher direct, PMP, programmatic guaranteed)?  
- What identity/measurement stack do you use for cross-screen measurement and deduplication? Can you run incrementality tests?  
- How do you prevent fraud and ensure viewability on CTV?  
- Who creates and optimizes creative? Do you offer dynamic creative insertion?  
- Reporting access: raw logs or just dashboards? How often?  
- Minimum spend and fee structure (media markup vs flat fee vs % of spend)?

If you want, tell me:
- Your objective (brand awareness, conversions, leads),  
- Monthly budget,  
- Geography (US, EMEA, APAC, local), and  
- Whether you want programmatic or platform-direct buys —

and I’ll recommend the top 3 agency/platform matches and draft 6–8 RFP questions you can send to shortlisted partners.
